podcast.title: Playing with Family
podcast.body: Wolfgang Van Halen has played bass in his father Eddie Van Halen's and uncle Alex Van Halen's band for many years. "Wolfgang Van Halen has been playing bass in his dad and uncle's band for years."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Son of Eddie Van Halen
podcast.body: Wolfgang Van Halen is mentioned as the son of renowned musician Eddie Van Halen. "More recently we have Wolfgang Van Halen son of Eddie."
